announcement-bar.label: Announcement bar
announcement-bar.note: The thin strip above the header: it carries the strongest offer or promise (free shipping, COD, delivery time). Check the copy length and whether it rotates.

header.label: Header / navigation bar
header.note: Logo, primary navigation, search, account and cart. Older captures (before Nov 2026) include the announcement bar above it; new captures split them into separate shots.

mega-menu.label: Mega menu / desktop dropdown
mega-menu.note: A desktop navigation item opened: dropdown or mega menu that lets shoppers shop by need (category, concern, collection), often with imagery.

mobile-nav.label: Mobile navigation (open menu)
mobile-nav.note: The burger menu opened on a phone: how categories, images, promos and account/help links are stacked so shoppers reach a collection in one or two taps.

search.label: Search (open / empty)
search.note: Search opened before typing: look for trending searches, popular products or collections that guide the shopper before they type.

search-results.label: Search results
search-results.note: Results after typing a query: predictive suggestions, product thumbnails with price, and a clear "view all results" path.

hero.label: Hero / above the fold
hero.note: First screen: one clear promise, one primary CTA, product visible. Check how the headline names the outcome and where the CTA sits on mobile.

category-tiles.label: Category tiles
category-tiles.note: Visual shortcuts into collections - lowers clicks to a product.

brand-story.label: Brand story section
brand-story.note: Storytelling section that builds brand trust.

comparison.label: Comparison section
comparison.note: Us vs them / product comparison: answers 'why this one' objections.

quiz.label: Quiz / product finder
quiz.note: Guided selling: quiz routes undecided shoppers to a product. Idea for 'find your guppy'.

bundle-builder.label: Bundle builder
bundle-builder.note: Build-a-bundle raises AOV. Maps to Pair / Trio / Starter tank kits.

collection.label: Collection page (PLP)
collection.note: Full collection / listing page: banner, filters and sort, grid density, badges and how many products are visible on the first screen.

product-card.label: Product card / grid
product-card.note: Card shows image, price, rating/review count, badges (new, bestseller, % off) and often quick-add. Copy the information hierarchy.

pdp.label: PDP - gallery + buy box
pdp.note: Above-the-fold product page: gallery, title, rating, price with savings, variant swatches / pack-size chips, primary add-to-cart.

variant-selector.label: Variant / pack-size selector
variant-selector.note: Option chips/swatches near the price. Map to Pair / Trio / Group, male/female, strain colour.

subscribe-save.label: Subscribe & save buy box
subscribe-save.note: Pre-selects a subscription with a clear % off and free shipping, turning a one-off order into recurring revenue while making the price look lower.

delivery-check.label: Delivery / pincode check
delivery-check.note: Pincode / serviceability check before purchase: answers 'can you deliver to me, and when?' — essential for perishable or live products.

product-configurator.label: Product configurator / step builder
product-configurator.note: Step-by-step visual picker (style → quantity → upload/confirm) that turns a complex or personalised product into easy choices and keeps shoppers moving toward checkout.

pdp-details.label: PDP - details / accordions / trust
pdp-details.note: Below the buy box: benefits, accordions, delivery & returns, guarantees. Where objections get answered.

sticky-atc.label: Sticky add-to-cart (mobile)
sticky-atc.note: Mobile scroll state of the PDP - look for a sticky ATC / buy bar that keeps the CTA in reach.

reviews.label: Reviews / social proof
reviews.note: Review widgets, star summaries, UGC and testimonials - core trust builder.

cross-sell.label: Cross-sell / pair it with
cross-sell.note: Adds related products right where the decision happens.

cart-drawer.label: Cart drawer
cart-drawer.note: Slide-out cart after add-to-cart: look for a free-shipping/gift threshold bar, upsells and coupon nudges.

free-gift.label: Free gift picker / gift-with-purchase
free-gift.note: Lets shoppers pick a free gift in the cart (or unlock one at a spend threshold) — a tangible reward that lifts AOV and makes the order feel like a deal.

cart-page.label: Cart page
cart-page.note: The full /cart page: line items, savings, delivery promise, upsells and a single clear checkout button.

checkout.label: Checkout
checkout.note: First checkout step reached without signing in or paying: express pay options, contact/address order and trust cues.

footer.label: Footer
footer.note: Newsletter capture, policy links, payment/trust icons, social.
